verdict.rationale: cursor-docs-4 directly claims the feature ('Inspect diffs, run checks, and catch problems before you merge') and cursor-docs-10 notes Cursor reviews PRs in GitHub, suggesting some diff/review workflow support, but there is no detailed documentation on what checks are run, how diffs are inspected, or independent/hands-on corroboration of this working in practice. missing for 10: detailed docs on diff inspection UI, specifics of automated checks (linting/tests), independent verification that this catches real issues before merge.
